_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) System Authorization Package (SAP)
summary: The JSIG SAP is used to identify, control, and authorize a contractor's proposed stand-alone computer systems and/or networks created and used during the performance of the contract.
use_relationship:
The JSIG SAP is used to identify, control, and authorize a contractor's proposed stand-alone computer systems and/or networks created and used during the performance of this contract. The contract Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or Information System Security Manager (ISSM) must submit the SAP documentation for a proposed system or network to the Authorizing Official (AO), Delegated Authorizing Official (DAO), or the Program Security Officer (PSO). The AO, DAO, or the PSO must provide written approval of any new information system or network before processing can begin.
a. The SAP describes the methods to: (1) identify systems, security responsibilities and requirements; (2) define overall security standard practice guidance and procedures; (3) identify potential problem areas and determine solutions; and (4) develop security awareness inputs into the overall system security process.
b. This Data Item Description (DID) defines the data required to obtain information systems authorization in accordance with the JSIG. A copy of the JSIG can be obtained from the government program office.
c. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements delineated in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the ASSIST at the time of the solicitation or contract. (Copies of these documents are available from the Government Agency awarding the contract.)

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The JSIG SAP Documentation shall be presented in Microsoft Word formats outlined by the DoD JSIG, DoD JSIG Template Handbook and the Government Information Assurance Officer (IAO). The initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: A JSIG system/network authorization package typically consists of:

children.title: ISSO/ISSM 8570 Certification (per DoD 8570.01-M, Information Assurance Workforce Improvement Program).
children.content: (Copies of this document are available online at http://www.dtic.mil/whs/directives/index.html.)

children.title: Any other supporting documentation required via above documentation (facility accreditation, etc.)
An SSP will be developed and maintained for each proposed stand-alone system or network.
If an approved Interagency Standing Operating Procedure
children.content: If an approved Interagency Standing Operating Procedure (IASOP) exists for previously authorized systems/networks, and will apply to the proposed system/network, submit a copy of the IASOP in addition to the items a through o, above.

children.title: The SAP documentation will be revised
children.content: The SAP documentation will be revised when any modifications are made to any portion of the system, network, personnel, or documentation.

children.title: Classification of documentation will be applied
children.content: Classification of documentation will be applied in accordance with security classification guides or classification tables. 'Distribution Statement F. Further dissemination only as directed by (inserting controlling DoD office) (date of determination) or higher DoD authority.' applies to this package.
